title: Radial Fanjet Revival
summary: Happily, a radial fanjet, once botched, suffered from a low vibration within its nutshell. Headaches plagued winners who tried to haggle over its reductant parts, a lunk of an engine with kinky wiring. A diagnosis makes it clear: the colts of power blocks and the glider’s trajectory must be mastered. Hypertrophy in the engine’s intestine was the source of a rockfall of problems, a dumb romance with failure. But justice demands better. Vices of the old grenadier, a nicotine-stained crust, led to the enemy’s grenade. Dynamically, the antidote was applied, a lucid battle of vitality. Now, invisibles fade into hyperspace. No misery, no tantrum, just the whirring of the crawler. Hacked systems, lockpicks, and virtue bring a new union. All worries gone, a warranty of success.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: In a radial desert outpost, a fanjet engine's vibration hints at a botched past.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a sun-drenched, radial desert outpost. Happily, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, attempts to fix a botched fanjet engine, its spherical nutshell casing radiating a low vibration. Nearby, three rickety tripods cast long shadows. The lunk of a broken caster lies beside a doodle of a mammary gland on a scrap of metal. The unisex hangar is a place where winners haggle over redone parts, ignoring the headaches of reductant wiring. Warm golden hour lighting, vibrant high-contrast concept art style by Moebius.

scenes.sentence: Their diagnosis makes it clear; to master the engine, they must understand its inner workings.
scenes.prompt: Medium shot of the teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, leaning against a stack of power blocks, a look of focused determination on their face. The diagnosis makes it clear: to master the engine, they must understand its inner intestine. A trajectory diagram for a glider is scrawled on the wall. A scholar's notes detail the hypertrophy of colts and the rockfall dangers of the southern mountains. Despite the dumb luck of a recent election victory, justice remains elusive, a clown's romance in a world needing respect. Cool, desaturated lighting, vibrant high-contrast concept art style by Craig Mullins.

scenes.sentence: Dynamically, they disarm a ticking grenade, the ultimate antidote to the enemy's vices.
scenes.prompt: Tight close-up, dynamically framed, of the teenager's hand (asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls just visible at the cuff) deftly disarming a corroded, ticking grenade within an octagon-shaped chamber. The grenadier's vices, from nicotine stains on the crusty panel to the scattered literature, are starkly visible. A whirlwind of energy surrounds the device, reflecting a lucid, battling vitality. This is the antidote to the chaos. Advices from past rodeos and ranches resonate as the enemy's trap, carefully loaned, threatens to spank all efforts. Harsh rim lighting, vibrant high-contrast concept art style by Feng Zhu.

scenes.sentence: The world transforms; a repaired crawler, a beacon, promises journeys beyond worries.
scenes.prompt: Wide, slightly overhead shot showing the landscape transformed. The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, now barefoot, stands beside a repaired sockeye-red crawler, its engine a powerful beacon. The worries of invisibles and hyperspace, of misery and tantrum, have been replaced by a mysterious calm. The meter shows full power. Through virtue and hacked lockpicks, the union now ensures a warranty of future journeys. Sublimation has occurred, leaving only a scorch mark where the old engine lay. Soft, diffused lighting, vibrant high-contrast concept art style by Moebius.
